name: Mesu Ochi! Ore no Netori-bou de Midara ni Aegu Senpai & Kouhai Tsuma 2 ~Mucchiri Nikuatsu no Kyonyuu Tsuma-tachi to no Icharabu Hame Seikatsu~
original_name: メス堕ち！オレのネトリ棒で淫らに喘ぐ先輩＆後輩妻2 ～ムッチリ肉厚の巨乳妻たちとのいちゃラブハメ性活～
source:
The main character is a very ordinary office worker.
Work is going well, but he is living a lonely single life.

One day, his senior and boss Takashiro Satsuki asked him to take care of the younger Okazaki Mahiro who had been assigned to work alone, and the situation changed completely.

The contact between the attractive senior wife and the junior wife
connected not only the mind but also the body...
